summary: A Depth 20 subscription on NSE: the book goes to Dhan's twentydepth socket and the quote to the market feed; a book made of both halves before any quote has no quote fields, and the next one carries the quote that came meanwhile.

notes: Worked by hand from dhan_websocket.py:889-912 (20 rows of f64 price, u32 quantity, u32 orders; code 41 bids, 51 asks) and dhan_adapter.py:791-859 (each half kept until the other comes, then one DEPTH publish).

deviations.reason: A depth frame keeps ltp, which the SDK's Depth callback reads: 0 before the instrument's first quote, its last traded price after; the web's 20-level frame has no ltp.

A 20-level packet has no totals, so the book frame takes them from the instrument's latest quote on the market feed (1.0.6 decision, kept: the depth frame carries the latest quote); before any quote they are left out, as on the web.
deviations.ref: decisions.md (Kept: depth frame keeps ltp + timestamp + latest quote); feed::bridge::depth_update
